dashboard-summary: Same folder and same `paths` glob as dashboard-use, and both exemplars (`useEconomySummary`, `useWorkspaceSummary`) are ordinary query hooks whose shape the use mold already teaches — a second mold loading alongside it would only repeat the query-key/enabled/staleTime rules.
rt-azure: Only `pr_azure.rs` declares `Azure*` types (`AzureRemote`, `AzurePrRest`, `AzureTransport`); `pr_provider.rs` merely references them, and a NEW provider adapter must not be named `Azure*` — the teachable shape here is "one adapter module behind the port", already taught by rt-pr-pattern from the same files.
rt-branch: `work_kind.rs` declares no `Branch*` type at all (its types are `WorkKind`, `UnitBase`, `BaseFlow`), so the cluster is a single file — `branch_state.rs` — and the plain-data + injected-reader shape its `Branch*` types follow is already covered by rt-pr-pattern, which is grounded in that same module.
